_readme.what: Example settings overrides for scripts/setup-harsll.mjs --settings <file>. Copy to config/<environment>.local.json (ignored by Git) and change the values. Every value here is a made-up placeholder.
_readme.rules: Give only the settings that differ from the defaults in workflows/harsll-settings.json; any of its keys may be given except the table and workflow IDs, which the script always fills in. Unknown keys and wrong types stop the script. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_readme.environment: profile names the copy. inputFolder, archiveFolder, rejectedFolder and reportsFolder are paths inside the n8n container; the file trigger watches inputFolder. rbisBaseUrl is the address of RBIS (the pretend RBIS is http://mock-rbis:8080).
_readme.email: summaryEmailTo receives the batch summaries and rejection notices; summaryEmailFrom is the sender. The mail server itself is the SMTP credential in n8n, not a setting.
_readme.businessRules: The other settings (landlordNames, deathHandling, maxAttempts and so on) are business rules. Each default is an assumption until the process owner confirms it: see docs/design/HARSLL-n8n-design.md. Override them here only when confirmed for this environment.
